_comment: Not a Claude Code/Kilo-native manifest - neither tool's plugin installer reads or enforces this. Same convention as skill-requirements.json: a separate, self-consistent file our own scripts can check, kept out of plugin.json to avoid depending on whether that schema tolerates unknown keys.

dependencies.reason: orchestration-methodology and task-spec-authoring reference the task/ tree convention (CONTEXT.md, 00-INDEX.md, specs/, NN-<slug>/plan.md) that skill owns - not vendored here.
